newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested, but some live basis sales were $1.00 per cwt higher. Buyer inquiry continued good. Seller interest limited by the fact that most showlists already traded.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights )
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1350 lbs - several pens in far Western area 70.00; few on a dressed basis 112.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1225 lbs - several pens in far Western area 70.00; few on a dressed basis 112.00-112.50.
